title: Panda dancing
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- dance floor glow -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='88' rx='32' ry='6' fill='#2b3a5c' opacity='0.8'/>

  <!-- left leg kicked out -->
  <path d='M38 66 Q28 72 22 66' stroke='#9b8fc7' stroke-width='6' stroke-linecap='round' fill='none'/>
  <ellipse cx='20' cy='64' rx='5' ry='4' fill='#3b2f63'/>

  <!-- right leg -->
  <path d='M60 66 Q70 74 76 70' stroke='#9b8fc7' stroke-width='6' stroke-linecap='round' fill='none'/>
  <ellipse cx='78' cy='69' rx='5' ry='4' fill='#3b2f63'/>

  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='56' rx='18' ry='17' fill='#c9d8ff'/>
  <!-- body belly patch -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='58' rx='12' ry='12' fill='#8fb0f5'/>

  <!-- left arm up -->
  <path d='M35 48 Q22 40 18 28' stroke='#9b8fc7' stroke-width='6' stroke-linecap='round' fill='none'/>
  <circle cx='17' cy='26' r='5' fill='#3b2f63'/>

  <!-- right arm up -->
  <path d='M65 48 Q78 40 82 28' stroke='#9b8fc7' stroke-width='6' stroke-linecap='round' fill='none'/>
  <circle cx='83' cy='26' r='5' fill='#3b2f63'/>

  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='28' r='17' fill='#e6eeff'/>
  <!-- left ear -->
  <circle cx='36' cy='14' r='6' fill='#5b4a94'/>
  <!-- right ear -->
  <circle cx='64' cy='14' r='6' fill='#5b4a94'/>

  <!-- left eye patch -->
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='26' rx='7' ry='6' fill='#5b4a94'/>
  <!-- right eye patch -->
  <ellipse cx='58' cy='26' rx='7' ry='6' fill='#5b4a94'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='43' cy='26' r='2.6' fill='#d9faff'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='26' r='2.6' fill='#d9faff'/>
  <circle cx='43.8' cy='25.2' r='0.9' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='57.8' cy='25.2' r='0.9' fill='#ffffff'/>

  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='33' rx='3' ry='2.2' fill='#3b2f63'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M45 36 Q50 41 55 36' stroke='#7fa7f0' stroke-width='1.8' stroke-linecap='round' fill='none'/>

  <!-- dance sparkles -->
  <path d='M14 44 l2 4 l4 -1' stroke='#ffe27a' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round' fill='none'/>
  <path d='M86 46 l-2 4 l-4 -1' stroke='#ffe27a' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round' fill='none'/>
  <circle cx='30' cy='15' r='1.8' fill='#8ef0ff'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='14' r='1.8' fill='#8ef0ff'/>
</svg>
